text:
talia: Heads-up I opened a PR to add a small decision flow + YAML example for choosing quant profiles (int4 vs int8) and a short Rust SDK snippet showing prefix prefetch usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5310 :sparkles:
omar: Nice. Can you paste the Rust snippet here so I can sanity-check the API names?
talia: Sure, excerpt in PR. Main flow uses `PrefetchClient::new()` and `client.prefetch(prefixes).await;` I also included a tiny `quant_profile: qprof-slim-int4` YAML example for users to copy into migration manifests.
jules: UX note: call out that int4 can reduce memory/cost but may have a "minimal observed quality delta" and link to the evals guide. Avoid words like "no change".
talia: Good call, reworded to "minimal observed quality delta" and linked to /docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts.
link-bot: link-check: found internal anchor mismatch for qprofiles page (/docs/optimize/qprofiles -> /docs/optimize/quant/profiles).
talia: Fixed anchor in PR to /docs/optimize/quant/profiles#qprof-slim-int4 and pushed.
ci-bot: CI: md-lint passed, snippets/rustfmt failed (1 file)
talia: Running rustfmt and pushing a quick fix.
(1m later)
talia: Pushed formatting fix and removed an extraneous `println!` from the snippet.
ci-bot: CI: snippets/rustfmt passed, link-check passed, preview build available

preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quant-decision-yaml
omar: Quick tech nit: in Rust SDK we renamed `KVCache` -> `KVCacheClient` in v0.10; make sure the snippet shows `use redwood_sdk::KVCacheClient;`. Also prefer showing `let client = PrefetchClient::builder().with_opts(opts).build().await?;` so users see builder pattern.
talia: Updated the snippet to use `KVCacheClient` and the builder pattern. Mentioned migration `OldKV -> KVCacheClient` in a one-liner.
jules: For the YAML sample can you add the exact test knobs so people can reproduce perf numbers? Keep it succinct: batch, seq_len, hw, quant id.
talia: Added a tiny bullet under the sample: - hw: A100 - batch: 8 - seq_len: 1024 - quant_profile: qprof-slim-int4 - observed: ~7.5ms/token with ~82% prefix hit
ci-bot: link-check: found 1 external redirect (partner integration)
talia: Replaced partner URL with canonical marketplace URL. Pushed.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer requested, [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [ ] UX wording final review
omar: One more micro: show error handling around `client.prefetch(...).await` to avoid panics in examples. Maybe `if let Err(e) = client.prefetch(...).await { log::warn!("prefetch failed: {}", e); }`.
talia: Added that pattern and pushed.
jules: UX wording looks good. One tiny suggestion: put the decision flow as an expandable callout so the page stays scannable.
talia: Moved decision flow into an expandable and pushed.
ci-bot: all checks green on the latest commit, deploy preview updated
talia: Merged and deployed to staging -> https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quant-decision-yaml (smoke preview looks OK)
omar: Quick smoke: snippets render, code highlight fine, anchors resolve.
jules: Verified evals link and qprofile anchor. lgtm.
talia: Thanks everyone! Hoping this reduces a few support tickets and makes the quant tradeoffs clearer. :tada:
